name: Noon. ~Itsumo yori Sukoshi dake Nagakatta Ano Natsu no Ichinichi~
original_name: NooN.～いつもより少しだけ長かったあの夏の一日～
source:
story

Wrapped in the morning scent of the classroom, I was attending summer vacation make-up classes. As usual, I dozed off. When I came to, I was alone in an empty classroom.

With no choice but to go home, I walked down the familiar country road. Feeling the summer breeze, I stopped. There, I met a girl.

I meant only to guide her, but before I knew it, I was drawn to her. And so I came to touch her "love" —

One strange thing after another. Like a continuation of a dream. Even her very presence feels elusive…

Who is she? Why did she appear before me? Why does she —

Midsummer noon. When dreams, promises, and feelings overlap, their summer slowly comes to a stop.

[From [url=http://tarupito.net/circle.html]Development team's official page (tarupito)[/url] - Translated from Japanese]

Brief Summary

Main character attends supplementary summer classes. Exhausted by the noon heat he falls asleep without realizing it. He meets a mysterious girl and feels the touch of love from her. It's summer heat when dreams and reality mix and feelings overlap.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-october-2004-akai-ito.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
故事

教室里弥漫着清晨的气息，我正在参加暑假补习。和往常一样，我打起了瞌睡。回过神来时，空荡荡的教室里只剩下我一个人。

我别无选择，只好回家，沿着熟悉的乡间小路前行。感受着夏日微风，我停下脚步。就在那里，我遇见了一名少女。

我原本只是想给她带路，却在不知不觉间被她吸引。于是，我触碰到了她的“爱”——

怪事接连发生，仿佛梦境仍在延续。就连她本身的存在，也显得缥缈难寻…

她是谁？为什么会出现在我面前？她为什么——

盛夏正午。当梦、约定与感情彼此重叠，他们的夏天渐渐停下了脚步。

[摘自[url=http://tarupito.net/circle.html]开发团队官方网站（tarupito）[/url]——翻译自日文]

简介

主人公在暑假参加补习。正午的暑热令他疲惫不堪，不知不觉间睡了过去。他遇见一名神秘少女，并从她身上感受到爱的触碰。盛夏的炎热中，梦境与现实相互交融，感情彼此重叠。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-october-2004-akai-ito.html]vndbreview[/url]]
